title: KEDA CloudEvent
description: Schema for CloudEvents emitted by KEDA when scaling-related events occur. Events follow the CloudEvents specification v1.0 and are delivered to HTTP or Azure Event Grid destinations configured in a CloudEventSource or ClusterCloudEventSource resource.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version. Always 1.0 for KEDA events.

type.description: CloudEvent type identifier. Always com.cloudeventsource.keda for events emitted by KEDA.

source.description: URI identifying the KEDA instance that emitted the event, in the format /{cluster-name}/{keda-namespace}/keda.

subject.description: URI identifying the specific resource that triggered the event, in the format /{cluster-name}/{namespace}/{object-type}/{object-name}.

id.description: Unique identifier for this CloudEvent instance.

time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was emitted.

datacontenttype.description: MIME type of the data field. Always application/json.

EventData.description: Payload data carried by a KEDA CloudEvent, providing machine-readable reason code and human-readable detail message.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code identifying the type of scaling event that occurred.

message.description: Human-readable description providing context about the scaling event, including which resource was affected and any error details.
message.example: Error when getting metric for trigger type kafka. Unable to connect to broker at kafka-broker:9092

CloudEventSource.description: Kubernetes custom resource that configures where KEDA delivers CloudEvents. CloudEventSource is namespace-scoped; ClusterCloudEventSource is cluster-scoped.

apiVersion.description: API version for the KEDA CloudEventSource resource.

kind.description: Resource kind. CloudEventSource is namespace-scoped; ClusterCloudEventSource applies cluster-wide.

CloudEventSourceSpec.description: Specification for a CloudEventSource defining the destination and optional event type filters.

clusterName.description: Optional cluster name included in the CloudEvent source and subject fields. Defaults to the Kubernetes cluster name if discoverable.

authenticationRef.description: Optional reference to a TriggerAuthentication for authenticating CloudEvent delivery to the destination.

CloudEventDestination.description: Destination configuration for CloudEvent delivery. Either an HTTP endpoint or Azure Event Grid topic must be configured.

http.description: HTTP destination configuration for CloudEvent delivery.

uri.description: HTTP(S) URL to which KEDA will POST CloudEvents.

azureEventGridTopic.description: Azure Event Grid destination configuration for CloudEvent delivery.

endpoint.description: Azure Event Grid topic endpoint URL.

EventSubscription.description: Optional event type filter configuration for the CloudEventSource.

includedEventTypes.description: When specified, only events with these reason codes are delivered. All others are suppressed.

excludedEventTypes.description: Events with these reason codes are suppressed and not delivered.
